title: SPEC5: Worker Service Configuration System
summary: config_system.py fully conforms to Subtask 2 of spec.md. All 11 schema keys, type coercion rules, priority cascade, error handling, and API contract verified against the authoritative specification (not the partial config_schema.json).

checks.detail: All 11 keys present with correct type, default, env var, and validation bounds: queue_url(string,non-empty), concurrency(int,1-32), max_retries(int,0-20), retry_backoff_seconds(int,1-300), job_timeout(int,1-3600), log_level(enum DEBUG/INFO/WARN), dead_letter_queue(bool), heartbeat_interval(int,5-300), prefetch_count(int,1-100), ack_on_failure(bool), metrics_enabled(bool). Schema defined once at module level (_SCHEMA), not duplicated.

int: parses int strings via int(); raises ConfigValidationError on non-parseable strings; rejects bool (subclass guard) and rejects float without silent truncation; range checked inclusive via min/max.
float branch present (parses float, rejects bool, rejects non-numeric) as required by the coercion spec; no schema key currently uses float so it is inert but compliant.
bool accepts true/false (case-insensitive), 1/0, yes/no, on/off string inputs; also accepts native bool and int 0/1; strips whitespace; raises ConfigValidationError for any other string.
enum validates coerced string against allowed values; case-sensitive (log_level rejects 'info'); non-string rejected.

Order is cli_args > env_vars > config_file > defaults. Layers applied low-to-high (defaults -> file -> env -> cli), so higher priority overrides lower. A key is 'provided' only when key present AND value is not None; empty string '' counts as provided and is still overridden by a non-None higher-priority value.
All 11 CELERY_* env var names map to the correct config keys. env_vars=None defaults to os.environ.

JSON object with config keys as fields; unknown keys ignored (k in schema filter); non-dict JSON safely ignored; missing file raises FileNotFoundError via open(); JSON syntax errors propagate naturally.
ConfigValidationError subclasses ValueError. Every validation error message includes key name and invalid value (format: "Config key '{key}' has invalid value {value!r}: <reason>").

load_config(config_file=None, env_vars=None, cli_args=None), get_schema(), validate_value(key, value) signatures match spec. get_schema() returns a deep copy (caller mutation cannot corrupt internal schema). load_config returns all 11 keys populated with defaults when no source provides a value.
